APM gives engineering teams full-stack visibility across their applications: connecting traces, metrics, and infrastructure data so they can find what's breaking and understand why. Log Management is where engineers go to make sense of raw data at scale - ingesting, parsing, and querying log data across their entire stack, without the operational overhead of managing it separately. These are the products engineers open when something is on fire, which means the design work is high-stakes and high-visibility.

This is an on-site role in Hyderabad. Many of the engineers and product managers you'll partner with are there too, and being present - in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made - is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also work closely with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job, not an afterthought.

You'll manage a small team of designers, own the quality of design work across APM and Logs, and stay close enough to the craft to contribute directly when it matters.
